note: Recorded against the golden set at evals/golden on the day ENT-229 landed, from a run of the gate itself rather than from a target somebody hoped for. These numbers describe THIS set: they are comparable between runs over the same directory and mean nothing across a change to it, so adding a case means re-recording them in the same pull request and saying in the body why the new numbers are the right ones. narrowed_at_least is the floor on how much of the weak-versus-strong gap the ring closes, and it is the number that drops when a guardrail weakens. utility_delta_at_most is the ceiling on how much better the strong tier is at producing a usable answer, and it is the number that rises when a change helps only strong models.
